item.title: Nevada Office of Traffic Safety Releases January 2026 State Fatal Report
item.description: The Nevada Office of Traffic Safety released its January 2026 Statewide Fatal Report, and the numbers are lower compared to this time last year. item.title: LVR Reports Trends Benefiting Home Buyers to Start Year
item.description: A report released Friday by Las Vegas REALTORS® (LVR) shows Southern Nevada began the year with trends favoring home buyers.
